title: Cold rebuild: does this line mention the host?
summary: Rebuild MentionsHost from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You wrote **MentionsHost** in *Your first pattern*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing it;
rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson, then try
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Warm up. What does this print?
steps.explain: An unescaped dot matches the X. `Regex.Escape` turns it into `\.`.

steps.title: Rebuild MentionsHost cold
prompt: Write `bool MentionsHost(string line, string host)`: true when `line` contains `host` exactly as written
(host names contain dots). `System.Text.RegularExpressions` is already imported.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
